title: Missed clock-in or clock-out: confirm the times with the client
when: A caregiver did not clock in or clock out in AxisCare, and the shift is over. The Hub does the watching: no clock-in 5 minutes into a shift, the caregiver gets a text asking her to clock in and the office gets texts until someone marks it Resolved; no clock-out 10 minutes after the shift ends, the caregiver gets one text asking her to clock out. No clock-out 30 minutes after the shift ends, or a shift that ended with no clock-in, puts a card in Needs Attention: "Call Ruth to confirm Maria's times." Overnight, any visit from yesterday still missing a time gets the same card.
owner: Whoever is on duty in the office
steps: Open the card and tap Call. It rings your phone and connects from the office line.

Speak with the client, or the family member who handles their care. Ask: "Was Maria with you today? What time did she get there, and what time did she leave?" Let them tell you the times rather than reading them out.
On the card, record who you spoke with, the times they gave, and any notes.
Correct the visit in AxisCare with those times, then tick Fixed in AxisCare. The card closes.
If the client can't remember or isn't sure: call the family member on file. If nobody can confirm, don't change the times. Write down what was said.
If nobody answers: leave a message and try again later the same day. The card stays open until it's done.
If a caregiver keeps missing clock-ins or clock-outs: the weekly Caregiver EVV Review flags it, and you decide the next step there.
done_when: The visit in AxisCare has the times the client confirmed, and the card is closed.
escalate_if: The client says the caregiver wasn't there: don't change the times. Record a call-off or no-show on the caregiver's attendance and tell Samantha.

why.text: We no longer use the EVV correction form. When a time is missing, the office calls the client to confirm it.
